integrity: The complete symbolic identities and direct matrix checks are in a separately embedded reproducible script. The infinite-frequency proof is analytic; no independence or external certification claimed.
scientific_limitations: Exact coefficient-to-sample squared spectrum only for symmetric two-sided exponential generator and paired alternating critical-density grids; not the synthesized-function L2-normalized sampling bounds or arbitrary irregular grids. Older equivalent periodic-spline formulas cannot be excluded absolutely.
title: Two spectral bands and an exact conditioning law for alternating Laplace-kernel sampling
